content: Spilled water never returns to the tray.
author: Japanese Proverbs
sourceWork: Fukusui bon ni kaerazu (覆水盆に返らず)
explanation: Once a porcelain cup tips over, no amount of sorrow or anger can draw the tea back into the vessel. The wise person observes the wet table, acknowledges the reality without drama, picks up the cloth, and wipes it clean. Energy spent mourning irreversible facts is life wasted.
practicalInsight: If an irreversible loss or mistake occurs today, utter zero complaints. Direct 100% of your attention to what can be constructed next.
reflectionPrompt: Where are you arguing with reality about something that has already happened and cannot be altered?
